$comment: Canonical Mattermost v4 endpoints used by chanvoy. PER-032 AC #11 — single source of truth for URL contract.
Every chanvoy verb that issues an HTTP request to Mattermost has its method + path template recorded here.
Path placeholders use {name} syntax and expand to the stable test values defined in tests/url_shape_replay.rs.
All paths are relative to the Mattermost v4 API root (/api/v4). The chanvoy MattermostClient prepends /api/v4 to every request.
Adding a new MM-endpoint usage to chanvoy-core must land an entry here first (schemas-before-code invariant).

list_teams.comment: Bot team-membership enumeration. Hit by the PER-019 γ hybrid resolver on every team-bearing verb. Cached after first fetch.

team_by_name.comment: Per-team lookup by slug. Hit by the γ hybrid resolver when an explicit --team override or <team>/<channel> syntax is used.

list_team_channels.comment: Bot per-team channel membership listing. Hit by channels verb and the auto-setup cursor seeder.

list_user_channels.comment: Cross-team channel enumeration for the bot user. `per_page` is a query filter, not part of the URL identity.

channel_by_name.comment: Per-channel lookup by name within a resolved team. Hit by every channel-targeting verb.

channel_posts.comment: Channel posts read. Query-string variants (?since=, ?after=, ?per_page=) are call-site filters; URL identity is the base path. PER-032 Item I's contract test asserts the daemon does not couple cursor state to this endpoint.

channel_pinned.comment: Channel pinned posts. Originally shipped as /pinned_posts (404 in production); fixed to canonical /pinned in PR #25 / v0.2.1. PER-032 Item J / AC #11 — this endpoint is the load-bearing case for the URL-shape drift class. A regression here must fail Tier-A replay before reaching live MM.

post_by_id.comment: Anchor-post existence probe. Hit by `assert_post_in_channel` / stale-cursor detection. PER-034 also routes through this endpoint via `fetch_post_pinned_state` to surface `was_already_pinned` / `was_already_unpinned` without an extra round-trip.

post_thread.comment: Thread enumeration. Used by `post --reply-to` to validate the parent post exists on the resolved channel before constructing the reply.

user_by_username.comment: User lookup by username. Hit by since-last-mine (resolves the bot's own username for the search filter) and DM/add-member verbs (resolve target user).

user_by_id.tier_b_dropped_rationale: peer-principal dependent — see brief §Scope J dropped-verb rationale. URL contract guarded here in Tier-A.
user_by_id.comment: User lookup by id. Hit by DM-family verbs to resolve a counterparty.

create_post.comment: Post creation. Same endpoint for channel posts, thread replies, and DM sends; differentiated by channel_id + optional root_id in body.

create_channel.comment: Channel creation. Smoke must clean up the created channel (archive) before declaring success.

create_direct_channel.tier_b_dropped_rationale: peer-principal dependent — see brief §Scope J dropped-verb rationale. URL contract guarded here in Tier-A.
create_direct_channel.comment: DM channel resolution. POST body carries [my_user_id, other_user_id]; canonical DM channel returned.

restore_channel.tier_b_dropped_rationale: elevated-capability admin verb — see brief §Scope J dropped-verb rationale. URL contract guarded here in Tier-A.
restore_channel.comment: Channel restore (un-archive). Requires elevated-capability profile per chanvoy's PER-014 identity-drift gate / LOCAL_ONLY_METHODS posture.

add_channel_member.tier_b_dropped_rationale: peer-principal dependent — see brief §Scope J dropped-verb rationale. URL contract guarded here in Tier-A.
add_channel_member.comment: Channel membership add. Body carries the target user_id.

create_reaction.comment: Emoji reaction creation. Body carries {user_id, post_id, emoji_name}.

delete_reaction.comment: Emoji reaction removal. Idempotent on already-removed reactions (404 → success exit per the PER-024 contract).

pin_post.tier_b_dropped_rationale: Live smoke is best-effort: pin requires channel-admin on the disposable smoke channel. When the bot lacks admin, the verb degrades to manifest-only Tier-A coverage. PER-034 §Scope acknowledges this.
pin_post.comment: PER-034 pin write verb. Idempotent on already-pinned: chanvoy pre-reads is_pinned from the post object to surface `was_already_pinned` without an extra round-trip.

unpin_post.tier_b_dropped_rationale: Live smoke is best-effort: unpin requires channel-admin on the disposable smoke channel. PER-034 §Scope.
unpin_post.comment: PER-034 unpin write verb. Symmetric to pin_post; idempotent on already-unpinned via `was_already_unpinned`.

delete_channel.comment: Channel archive (soft delete). Reversible only via channel restore (which requires elevated capability).

search_posts.comment: Team-scoped post search. Hit by the search verb and by since-last-mine's authored-post lookup.
